paired_contrasts.empty_category_policy: Reject/redraw any resample missing an official category; never replace empty category with zero or silently change macro denominator. This conditions MMStar intervals on all18 categories being represented.
paired_contrasts.interval_scope: Pointwise exploratory 95% percentile interval conditional on one fixed base/checkpoint pair and this public benchmark. Resample entire image clusters and retain all paired questions. Nine predeclared task×seed comparisons, without multiplicity correction; no confirmatory significance or equivalence claim. Training-seed variability is separate; seed×image is never pooled as independent.

statistics.seed_estimator: arithmetic mean ± sample SD across seeds0/42/200; no mean CI with n3
statistics.image_intervals: Pointwise exploratory 95% percentile interval conditional on one fixed base/checkpoint pair and this public benchmark. Resample entire image clusters and retain all paired questions. Nine predeclared task×seed comparisons, without multiplicity correction; no confirmatory significance or equivalence claim. Training-seed variability is separate; seed×image is never pooled as independent.
statistics.multiplicity: nine pointwise exploratory comparisons, no adjustment and no confirmatory inference

limitations: The dev-selected BF16/1024 protocol changes quantization/storage, compute dtype and visual budget relative to historical NF4/FP32/256. Historical changes are joint-path observations, not pure BF16 or pure budget causal effects.
All adapters were trained using NF4/FP32 and visual budget256; BF16/1024 is an inference change with no new training.
Training qv seed0 used V100, seeds42/200 used A100; microbatch/reduction/dropout execution differs. Three-seed SD includes this heterogeneous lineage and does not isolate hardware effects.
Public val predictions were already measured under the historical protocol; benchmark pretraining overlap is unknown. Formal complete evaluation does not mean a clean unseen holdout.
Answer text frequency is exposure to actual normalized supervised targets in train_all, not semantic visual-class frequency, pretraining frequency, or causally controlled long-tail difficulty.
Slice scores are descriptive with no per-slice confidence intervals. Overall gains do not establish improvement on every unseen/rare slice.

Sampled absence of a co-resident GPU process does not establish exclusivity. Throughput excludes model loading, preflight, verification, disk/controller overhead and is not production service performance.
A high output agreement rate or an interval crossing zero does not prove numerical/accuracy equivalence; no equivalence margin was predeclared.
training_hardware_note: Existing seed0 trained on 4xV100; seeds42/200 on 2xA100. New inference ran on A100. Seed SD is not isolated from training hardware variation.
